description: Qwen-Image-2512 (Dec 2025 update). Pick it for PHOTOREAL and cinematic/painterly work: much more photographic skin, light and texture, grittier wallpapers, richer posters; text rendering as good as the original. Close portraits tend to crop the top of the head: ask for 'full head in frame' or a looser shot. Lightning 8-step, ~7 s warm. It ignores flat 2D, cel-shaded and picture-book asks and weakens style LoRAs, so use the original qwen-* workflows for those.
